4-14-24
The insured reported a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the claimant's vehicle, and the claimant is
represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
6-18-24
Confirmed that the driver involved is named on the policy and that the policy was active at the time of loss. Nothing in

7-4-24
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the claim. They confirm several details of the scene and the vehicle,
though no independent witnesses have come forward to describe the impact.
7-17-24
Police records and the statements gathered at the scene confirm the claimant was present in the vehicle at the time
of the collision.
8-30-24
The vehicle damage is consistent with the impact described by both parties. No prior damage to the vehicle is known
from our records or the repair history provided.
9-18-24
The claimant has reported a wrist fracture. The injury fits the type and force of the collision, and no earlier injury to the
same area is known from medical history or prior claims.
10-9-24
Received the claimant's account through counsel. The account has remained the same in every conversation so far,
with no changes in the sequence of events.
11-12-24
Medical records show treatment followed a typical course for this kind of fracture, with care tapering as the claimant's
condition improved. Requested updated records from the treating provider.
11-29-24
File remains open pending the outstanding medical records and the attorney's demand package. Reserves will be
reviewed once those documents are received.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
